title: Come to Me and Rest
reflectionQuestion: Jesus said you can bring him anything at all. What would you most like to tell him about today?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Comfort & Bedtime, comfort-ritual short-only). Adam's 'the one I'd fight hardest to include' -- pure medicine for the tired/sad/overwhelmed/scared child. mood=weary so it routes directly to that distress mood (Psalm 23's cousin). KEEP: 'Come to me, all you who are tired and carrying heavy things... and I will give you rest' + 'come just as you are' + 'you can bring him anything.' SKIP (per Adam): the 'yoke' imagery and any burden/obedience/discipleship explanation -- too abstract; this is comfort, not teaching. Closing is Adam's verbatim all-timer: 'Rest now, little one. Jesus is gentle and kind. You can bring him anything.' WEB-faithful but child-rendered (gentle frame + invitation), like the Beatitudes. VOICE_ARABELLA (the comfort-ritual voice -- Psalm 23, Beatitudes).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
